column1: # --dynmul on/off isolation: is the current-default dynmul=0 the regression?
# Everything else at compiled defaults. With dynmul>0 the static --cutoff is
# IGNORED (yals.c:5546-5549): the budget is purely dynamic -- each probe starts
# at 1000 flips and every probe-best improvement extends the deadline to
# D*(flips-so-far), so stuck probes restart fast (~1000 flips) while improving
# probes run long. dynmul=0 uses a flat static --cutoff (1000000 compiled
# default) for every probe. dyn10 reproduces the PRIOR default behavior
# (cutoff is moot for dyn10); dyn0 is the new compiled default.
